title: They're gonna get greedy
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: When you find a clever way to make money, who is going to want a piece of it?

groups.heading: Who's gonna give them the 15 cents?

lines.text: How does he think he will produce it cheaper? A student said: charge a fifteen cent fee per subscriber per month. Jose said: that's how he thinks he will make money. A subscription model.

Who is going to give them the fifteen cents, Jose asked? The household pays. And where does the money flow? To the cable company. So they collect fifteen cents a subscriber for the content he runs on his network.

groups.heading: Of course they're gonna get greedy

lines.text: Do you think they will sit around and give him millions of dollars for his fifteen cents, Jose asked? They will say: this guy is making millions sending his content through our networks, through fiber we paid to lay. Of course they are going to get greedy.

If you were a shareholder of one of those cable networks, and you saw him making that kind of money, what would you do? Not only negotiate. You'd say: why can't we do what he does? We have more money. We own the networks. Why should he make any money at all?

So this is going to be a fight, Jose said. It is not going to be an easy one for him. Today those networks own movie studios. It is a much more democratic situation than back then, when it was straight monopolies.
How is he going to make it cheaper? A student said: he doesn't do it in New York. Jose said: not really the answer. Everybody thought a news company had to be in New York. That is just perception.
What do you assume you have to do that is just perception?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write one way you plan to make money, in a sentence.
Write who else could want to take that money, and why.
Write what you would do if they got greedy.
Write one thing you assume you must do, that may be just perception.
Write one cheaper or smarter way to do it.

check.q: How did the student say the author thinks he will make money?
choices: A small fee per subscriber each month

check.q: What did Jose say the cable companies will be?
What did Jose say about everybody thinking a news company had to be in New York?

recap: Expect others to want their share. Check which of your rules are just perception.
